retrievalProfile.description: A retro-styled portrait framed within a thick cream border, featuring a central subject in front of a vintage vehicle with bold, red, custom-script typography overlapping the frame.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a woman with long dark hair adorned with small white daisies, standing in front of a teal-grey vintage truck. The image is contained within a rounded-corner square frame, set against a wide cream-colored border. Bold, red, stylized lettering is positioned at the top and bottom, breaking the frame's boundary.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered in front of a vintage truck
Typography overlapping the image and the cream border
Daisies in hair echoing the white of the dress and border
Red text providing a high-contrast focal point against the muted background
coreInvariants: Deep red color for all primary text
Vintage film-grain texture on the photograph

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and occupies the lower two-thirds of the inner frame, shown from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large red script at the top serve as primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top red script, down the subject's face, to the bottom red script, following a vertical central axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space is provided by the wide cream border surrounding the central image.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, desaturated photographic tones contrasted with high-saturation, high-value red text.

letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated swashes and flourishes on initial capitals
Letters are tightly packed and often interlocking
Underlining elements integrated into the letter tails
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'L' features a long, sweeping tail that underlines the word
The 'R' has a dramatic, curved leg that extends below the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A single custom-lettering style used for all primary text to maintain a cohesive brand identity.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s retro serif feel with decorative flourishes.
Matches the high-contrast, flourished nature of the top text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage-style photograph of a woman with daisies in her hair standing in front of a 1950s truck, placed inside a rounded-corner square frame on a wide cream background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom red script lettering at the top and bottom center, ensuring the flourishes overlap the transition between the photo and the cream border.

verificationChecks: Does the text overlap the image frame?
Is the outer border a solid cream color?
Are there daisies visible in the subject's hair?

mustAchieve: Harmonious integration of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check for rounded corners on the inner frame
Ensure red text is the most saturated element
Verify the cream border is uniform
Confirm the vintage truck is recognizable but muted
Check that typography flourishes feel hand-drawn
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Portrait + Rounded Frame + Cream Border + Red Script Overlay
